## Figma notes

Mirrors the Figma Skeleton colors: its two frames go from Background/Disabled/Strong to Background/Disabled/Soft. The pulse fades the Strong fill toward the Soft one instead of reproducing the Figma animation.

## Rules

- Import `Skeleton` from `@lucasdost/design-system`. Do not rebuild it with plain HTML and Tailwind classes.
- Style it through its props and variants first. Use `className` only for layout (margin, width, grid placement), never to change its colors, typography or radius.
- Colors come from the S0L tokens; see [color](../foundations/color.md).
